speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
text: asked the Minister for Health what is the reason for not closing our borders to travellers from India and Indonesia given the disproportionately large number of imported cases coming from these two countries.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Many of such workers are from India and Indonesia.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: If we close our borders to them, many Singaporeans will not be getting the keys to their homes, many households will have their FDWs delayed and will need to find alternative care arrangements for their loved ones.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Our economy will also slow down and the lives and livelihoods of many will be impacted.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Together, these measures help reduce the risk of transmission from newly arrived migrant workers into our community.
